objective: Provide generic bounded pagination that preserves item identity and responds safely to input changes and batched navigation.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Reusable pagination hooks remain common stateful React abstractions.

relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fits the existing level21custom-hook/slice lesson after state and reducers.

defects: Original only exercised the fixed seven-city,three-item App.
The named hook itself,generic item identity,empty data and changing inputs were untested.
Junior returned zero pages for empty input while the other two variants returned one.
Junior captured the current page in navigation instead of applying batched functional steps;all three lacked input-change clamping.
rationale: Export the named hook and provide its placeholder/App optional items/pageSize signature in starter while preserving default cities/3. Explicitly define dense readonly arrays<=1000arbitrary opaque values,pageSize integer1..100,pageItems preserving references,one-based page/count>=1even empty,bounded direct callbacks and repeated calls per event. Keep valid page on input changes or persist its nearest-valid clamp so later growth cannot resurrect invalid state;instances remain independent. App accepts unique literal strings<=2000units and renders exact slice/page text/current disabled flags. All three hook boards add guarded same-component stored-page adjustment during render,no effect/unconditional state loop;junior also gains max1and functional next/previous. Senior optional extra flags remain allowed. Original cases stay,one empty/custom-size visible example and three hidden cases cover readonly/opaque function-symbol-object identity,empty/one/seven/1000items,size100,last/first bounds,double-next batching,changed inputs/pageSize and concurrent/remounted hooks. An independent reducer hook passes. Four controls ignoring App inputs,unclamped shrink,JSON-cloned generic values and zero empty-page count pass originals and fail now. No applicable Big O target is invented.
